{"category_edits":[{"category":"learning_objective","rationale":"Across all four category models, retain 90% pointwise logistic supervision and add 10% pairwise ranking supervision to encourage positive-negative separation. Preserve global valid-position averaging, sampling, architecture, inference and training settings.","edits":[{"find":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    mask = (pos != 0).float()
    loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)","replace":"def bpr_sequence_loss(model: nn.Module, seq: torch.Tensor, pos: torch.Tensor, neg: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    pos_scores, neg_scores = model(seq, pos, neg)
    mask = (pos != 0).float()
    pointwise_loss = nn.functional.softplus(-pos_scores) + nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores)
    pairwise_loss = nn.functional.softplus(neg_scores - pos_scores)
    loss = 0.9 * pointwise_loss + 0.1 * pairwise_loss
    return (loss * mask).sum() / mask.sum().clamp(min=1.0)"}]}],"change_summary":"Replace the training loss with a 0.9 pointwise / 0.1 pairwise blend for all four datasets. Predictor and checkpoint shapes remain unchanged."}
